behavior: Bounded session-local private owned_requests pages, then complete uniform same-origin public accounting pages; no owned request ID or human grouping leaves the wallet.
Exact canonical PXE checkpoint and public revision guard every page. Partial results never publish zero or partial totals. Full eight-ID ownership page requires a further page.
Free private balance, allocated available, reserved, charged and historical refunded displayed separately. Returned credit is already inside free balance and never added twice.
Owned WAITING/ACTIVE requests with zero reservations can prepare existing cancel after explicit private-fee review. Fenced/reserved records show blocking conditions.
Bok withdraw uses the actual current private ABI and a saved amount/recipient/nonce/portal/token. L2 outcome blocks workflow replacement until an exact canonical L1 refund is verified.

Saved recipient reviews separate Ethereum gas; existing encrypted token-scoped journal sends once and recovers exact calldata plus PluginPortal Withdrawn event, canonical inclusion and testnet finality. Unknown/reorg/wrong wallet/scope changes cannot authorize a duplicate.

dependencies.build: Root normal SDK/wallet build required after composition; new PrivateBok utility class/artifact and authenticated scope.bok plus public endpoint must also be composed.

limits: Application tests use labelled private/public dependencies and a labelled new owned_requests ABI shape; actual current withdraw/cancel ABI is used. No claim of installed new-class utility acceptance.
Chromium tests are labelled DOM doubles with no live wallet, chain, proof or financial send.
Live uniform archive acquisition, actual private exit and settled PluginPortal refund remain unqualified.
Fee credits remain spend-only under actual FeeJuice protocol; no nonexistent redemption introduced.
Bok refund currently requires the saved receiving Ethereum wallet to pay gas; no gasless refund relay claimed.
Previously cancelled requests from old classes cannot be retroactively reconstructed by the new ownership utility.
sourceNote: Only API documentation was added after final runtime checks; no behavior changed. Full unrelated application tests were not repeated; 56 selected affected Bok/private-fee/RC22 cases ran, and session, Ethereum journal and synchronized-application suites ran in full.
